mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_skill s JOIN t_skill_publisher p ON p.publisher_id=s.publisher_id WHERE p.user_id=#{userId} AND p.status='ACTIVE'

SELECT s.skill_id,d.draft_id,COALESCE(r.name,s.slug) AS name,s.slug,s.status, d.status AS draft_status,j.status AS job_status,v.version_label,s.revision,s.update_time FROM t_skill s JOIN t_skill_publisher p ON p.publisher_id=s.publisher_id LEFT JOIN t_skill_draft d ON d.skill_id=s.skill_id AND d.owner_user_id=#{userId} LEFT JOIN t_skill_job j ON j.job_id=d.latest_job_id AND j.draft_id=d.draft_id LEFT JOIN t_skill_revision r ON r.revision_id=s.public_revision_id AND r.skill_id=s.skill_id LEFT JOIN t_skill_version v ON v.version_id=s.current_version_id AND v.skill_id=s.skill_id WHERE p.user_id=#{userId} AND p.status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY s.update_time DESC,s.skill_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
